findings.description: F-004: Lab 6's «Раздел 19.49 разбирал эту ловушку» pointed past the end of the chapter. The direction-vs-next_direction rule appears only in this very section (Labs 5-6). Shipped at 19-31-debug-labs.html:267.
findings.resolution: Replaced the self-referential dangling citation with «Ловушка тонкая: проверка обязана идти против state.direction…», keeping the explanation and dropping the phantom pointer. Verified by the chapter-wide out-of-range grep returning 0.

findings.description: F-020: Lab 4's broken snippet (`time.sleep(...); self.game_tick()`) is unbounded direct recursion — verified RecursionError after 999 self-calls — but the symptom text said the window freezes only «заданное число миллисекунд», and the explanation named only the blocking sleep.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the symptom to «Окно замирает НАВСЕГДА, а не на delay_ms: тик зовёт сам себя без условия выхода… примерно через 1000 вызовов программа падает с RecursionError», and expanded the explanation to name both bugs (blocking sleep AND base-case-free recursion) and to say that screen.ontimer() solves both.

findings.description: F-030.4: Lab 3's symptom line «Игра не умеет ставиться на паузу» uses a reflexive verb with an inanimate subject; its third symptom line also claimed CPU burn from a loop that (after F-001) now paces itself.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the symptom to «Игру нельзя поставить на паузу» and replaced the stale CPU-burn line with «Скорость задана одной константой и по ходу партии не меняется». The lab's broken snippet now shows the time.sleep(ZADERZHKA_SEK) line, and the lab title changed from «Busy-цикл…» to «Блокирующий цикл усложняет паузу и скорость».
